input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 contains only legal-compliance, authority, non-infringement and anti-bribery warranties. There is no express warranty that the Services or the Works will conform to the Specifications or documentation, no warranty period, no no-malicious-code warranty, and no repair/re-perform/refund remedy; the only performance standard is the bare covenant in 1(b), which carries no stated remedy. Combined with the implied-warranty disclaimer in 5(e), Company is left without a meaningful conformance warranty, short of the playbook preferred position (12 months software / 90 days services with repair, replace or refund). Redline inserts a new 5(f) with the workmanship, conformity and malicious-code warranties, the remedy, and a confirmation that 5(e) does not swallow the express warranties; fallback of 90/30 days offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add express conformity/workmanship/no-malicious-code warranty with repair-replace-reperform-or-refund remedy, and confirm the disclaimer does not swallow it
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 gives us authority, IP and anti-bribery warranties but no warranty that the Services and Works will actually conform to the Specifications, and no remedy if they do not. We have added a standard performance and conformity warranty (12 months for Works, professional and workmanlike Services), a no-malicious-code warranty, and a repair/re-perform/replace-or-refund remedy, and confirmed that the disclaimer in 5(e) does not cut back these express warranties. If 12 months is too long for your delivery model, we can accept 90 days for the Works and 30 days for Services with the same remedies.

ops.text: (f) Contractor represents and warrants to Company that: (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (ii) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, each of the Works will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and documentation; and (iii) the Works will not contain any virus, worm, malicious code or other routine designed to disable, damage or permit unauthorized access to the Works or Company's systems. For breach of the warranty in clause (ii) or (iii), Contractor shall, at Company's request, promptly repair or replace the non-conforming Works or re-perform the affected Services and, if Contractor fails to do so within thirty (30) days, refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Works or Services. Nothing in Paragraph 5(e) limits or disclaims the express warranties set forth in this Agreement.
